Strategy: Raise the widened sweet-band reward to twenty over residuals between twenty-eight and forty-eight while keeping the mid penalty at fifteen. This strengthens the pull toward reusable leftovers, but the larger bonus may override tight fits that Best Fit would choose well.
```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (20 if r - item >= 28 and r - item <= 48 else 0) - (15 if r - item >= 8 and r - item <= 22 else 0) for r in bins]
```
